post.summary: Log in (presence-only validation; any other miss is 401)
Change password (revokes other sessions; reset links stay valid)

delete.summary: Delete my account (revokes sessions, deletes bucket objects, then the user)

patch.summary: Change a user's role or disabled flag (admin; not on yourself)

post.summary: Create a pending file and a presigned PUT (signs Content-Type and Content-Length = size: send exactly size bytes)
Mark uploaded after checking the bucket

get.summary: Get a file and its download URL (presigned GET, Content-Disposition: attachment)
